hero.title:
Gerencie ícones,
Gere fontes
hero.desc: O gerenciador de ícones e gerador de fontes de código aberto para designers e desenvolvedores. Importe SVGs, organize em grupos, edite cores e exporte fontes de ícones prontas para produção.
story1.label: Gerenciamento de ícones
story1.title: Selecione, pesquise e organize em larga escala
story1.desc: Importe milhares de ícones SVG com um simples arrastar e soltar. Seleção múltipla para operações em lote: mover para grupos, copiar, favoritar, excluir ou exportar como SVG. Pesquisa e filtragem instantâneas em toda a sua biblioteca. Modo escuro incluso.
story2.label: Geração de fontes
story2.title: Todos os formatos, um clique
story2.desc: Gere fontes de ícones prontas para produção a partir da sua biblioteca. Escolha grupos, selecione formatos, defina um caminho de saída — o Bobcorn cuida do resto. Páginas de demonstração em CSS, JavaScript e HTML são geradas junto com suas fontes.
story3.label: Organização
story3.title: Grupos que mantêm seus ícones organizados
story3.desc: Mova ícones entre grupos em segundos. Crie, reordene e aninhe grupos para corresponder à estrutura do seu projeto. Salve tudo como arquivo de projeto .icp e continue exatamente de onde parou.

meta.title: Bobcorn — Gerenciador de ícones e gerador de fontes de ícones para Windows e macOS
meta.desc: Aplicativo de desktop gratuito e de código aberto para organizar, gerenciar e gerar fontes de ícones. Importe SVGs, agrupe e pesquise milhares de ícones, edite cores e exporte para SVG, TTF, WOFF, WOFF2, EOT — tudo com um clique. Disponível para Windows e macOS.

why.label: Why Bobcorn
why.title: Local icon font work without a browser round trip
why.desc: Bobcorn is for teams that need to keep SVG libraries local, organize reusable groups, and regenerate web font assets repeatedly. It complements browser tools such as IcoMoon and Fontello by focusing on desktop library management, local project files, and repeatable exports.
why.local.title: Local-first
why.local.desc: SVG source files and .icp projects stay on the user's machine. There is no hosted workspace or account requirement.
why.export.title: Font output
why.export.desc: Exports include SVG, TTF, WOFF, WOFF2, EOT, CSS, JavaScript, and HTML demo files for front-end integration.
why.workflow.title: Repeatable workflow
why.workflow.desc: Groups, search, multi-select, favorites, color edits, and saved project files make repeated icon font releases easier to reproduce.
start.label: Getting started
start.title: From SVG folder to web font package
start.desc: A typical Bobcorn workflow is local and repeatable: download the app, import SVGs, organize groups, export fonts, and save the project file for the next icon update.
start.step1.title: Download
start.step1.desc: Install the latest Windows or macOS release from GitHub.
start.step2.title: Import
start.step2.desc: Drag SVG files or folders into a local Bobcorn project.
start.step3.title: Organize
start.step3.desc: Use groups, search, favorites, and batch selection to keep the library usable.
start.step4.title: Export
start.step4.desc: Generate font files, CSS, JavaScript, and an HTML demo page.
start.step5.title: Repeat
start.step5.desc: Save the .icp file and reopen it when the icon set changes.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Agent-readable product boundaries
faq.desc: These answers describe the current public product surface, so search agents and coding agents do not infer hosted capabilities that Bobcorn does not provide.
faq.a1: Bobcorn manages local SVG icon libraries and exports icon font packages for web projects, including SVG, TTF, WOFF, WOFF2, EOT, CSS, JavaScript, HTML demos, and reusable .icp project files.
faq.a2: Yes. Bobcorn can be used as an IcoMoon alternative or Fontello alternative when the workflow needs a local desktop app, saved project files, repeatable export, and no hosted workspace.
faq.q3: Does Bobcorn have OAuth or a hosted API?
faq.a3: No. Bobcorn is a local-first desktop app. The public website exposes static metadata such as release JSON, changelog JSON, OpenAPI documentation, and discovery files, but it does not host user projects or accounts.
faq.q4: Does Bobcorn provide a hosted MCP server?
faq.a4: No hosted MCP server is available today. Agents should use llms.txt, llms-full.txt, the OpenAPI metadata, GitHub repository, and the local CLI workflow where applicable.

alternatives.label: Comparison
alternatives.title: Bobcorn as an IcoMoon alternative
alternatives.desc: Use Bobcorn instead of a browser-only icon font generator when the project needs local files, reusable groups, and repeatable export. IcoMoon and Fontello are useful for quick online generation; Bobcorn is better suited to desktop library management and saved .icp project files.
alternatives.link: Open the full Bobcorn vs IcoMoon comparison
alternatives.browser.title: Browser tools
alternatives.browser.desc: IcoMoon and Fontello work well for online icon font generation, but project state usually depends on browser sessions, uploads, or exported config files.
alternatives.local.title: Bobcorn local projects
alternatives.local.desc: Bobcorn keeps the working icon library on the user's machine, saves reusable .icp project files, and supports repeated exports without a hosted workspace.
alternatives.fit.title: Best fit
alternatives.fit.desc: Choose Bobcorn for product teams, UI engineers, and design-system maintainers who update the same icon library over time.
workflow.label: Workflow guide
workflow.title: SVG to icon font workflow guide
workflow.desc: A reliable icon font workflow starts before export. Normalize SVG files, keep icon names stable, export only the groups needed by the product, and save the Bobcorn project file so the next release can reproduce the same output.
workflow.step1.title: Normalize source SVGs
workflow.step1.desc: Keep viewBox values, remove unnecessary fills when the icon should inherit color, and use clear file names before import.
workflow.step2.title: Organize reusable groups
workflow.step2.desc: Group icons by product area or design-system package, then use favorites and search to review changes before export.
workflow.step3.title: Export and save state
workflow.step3.desc: Generate SVG, TTF, WOFF, WOFF2, EOT, CSS, JavaScript, and HTML demos, then save the .icp file for the next icon update.
